incidents.name: BYToken permissionless triggerAutoBurn
incidents.notes: BYToken.triggerAutoBurn() has no access control, so after cornering the BY supply and donating WBNB to satisfy the trading threshold the attacker burned the pair's BY reserve on demand and sold a dust amount of BY back for the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: BY 0x6f50cffEcd4e00EcF7E442774C08c089450B62Ca created 2026-06-03 by 0xa1819e27da8e69b1126aa9766f8ae649bc0ddba6, unrelated to attack sender 0x047547a4fa4a67c1032d249b49ec1a79c0460bad; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; 146.60 WBNB drained from pair 0x1F358e18e0DB68FF33C2319C8DaD328eDF9B7059 exactly one day after deployment
